title: Track-To-Track Fuser
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multi-Object Tracking Algorithms/Track_To_Track_Fuser.md
text: Track-to-Track Fusion, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Assignment algorithm name} sets Assignment algorithm; {Fuser Index} sets the unique index for track fuser, {Name of ’Custom’ assignment function}, {Threshold for assigning source to central tracks}, {Maximum number of central tracks}, {Maximum number of source configurations}, {Source configurations} sets the configuration of source systems struct, {Update source configurations with time}, {Track state parameters} sets the parameters of track state reference frame, {Update track state parameters with time}, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Confirmation threshold [M N]} sets the threshold for central track confirmation, {Deletion threshold [P Q]} sets the threshold for central track deletion, {Central track state size}, {Central track object attributes}, {State transition function}, {State transition Jacobian function}, {Process noise matrix}, {Enable additive process noise}, {State fusion function}, {Name of ’Custom’ fusion function} sets the name of custom assignment function function, {State fusion parameters source}, {Cross covariance factor}, {Optimize covariance based on} sets the intersection algorithm criteria, {State fusion custom algorithm parameters}, {Fuse only confirmed source tracks}, {Fuse coasted source tracks} sets the fuse only confirmed source tracks, {Prediction time source} sets the source of prediction time, {Enable tentative tracks output} enables output port for tentative tracks, {Enable all tracks output} enables output port for all tracks, {Enable information output} enables output port for analysis, {Source of output bus name} sets the source of output track bus name and {Source of output info bus name}. Values come from the instance.
